# Vale accepts these words in docs prose.
#
# Entries are case-insensitive, and possessives are derived automatically:
# `deployer` also accepts `Deployer`, `DEPLOYER`, and `deployer's`. Plurals are
# NOT derived, so a plural used in the docs needs its own entry (`keystore` and
# `keystores` are two lines). Verified against vale 3.14.2.
